fields.description: Global for Free Item, GWP, Gift Pool, Cart Total Gift and Brand Gift. Unchecked (default): a gift whose trigger item received Friends & Family is not given, and a cart-total gift is removed when F&F applies. Checked: the gift and F&F both apply. fields.description: Limit program cost. Leave 0 for no cap. When a cap is hit the Friends & Family discount is reduced (spread proportionally over the covered items) or not applied, with a message to the cashier.

fields.label: Max Discount per Order
fields.description: Maximum total Friends & Family discount on one invoice. 0 = no cap.

fields.description: Maximum cumulative Friends & Family discount one customer can receive in a calendar month (submitted invoices, net of returns). 0 = no cap.
